run.scope: Flutter MVP, functional review, UI acceptance, and non-uploading App Store preflight

worked: Reader-signal-to-revision-loop remained distinct from generic writing and publishing apps
Independent review found persistence and reassessment defects before final gate
Small-screen large-text tests found two real overflows
Simulator first launch exposed an immutable empty-list crash that static tests had missed
User feedback exposed that a revision-only workflow did not support real long-form novel work
The revised product now supports local novels, chapters, TXT/Markdown import, reading-time editing, and schema v1 to v2 migration
Final gate passed format, analyze, 29 tests, Android debug, and unsigned iOS archive
failed: Initial local-only storage rotation could resurrect deleted content
Initial fresh-install path attempted to sort an immutable empty list
First screenshot candidate retained an alpha channel
The first Chinese heading matcher misclassified body lines such as 第一章正文 as headings before its boundary rule was tightened
untested: Physical devices and iOS 15 minimum deployment
Actual external file selection from Files, iCloud, and third-party providers
Extreme long-text performance, GBK or GB18030 decoding, complete landscape, iPad core flow, low-storage, and forced-termination matrix
Signed distribution, upload, TestFlight processing, and App Review

lessons.symptom: The initial MVP required users to paste a draft into a revision form and had no durable novel or chapter editing workspace.
lessons.cause: The initial slice optimized the differentiating revision mechanism but omitted the long-form input and maintenance workflow needed before revision.
lessons.proposed_change: For long-form authoring products, validate capture and durable workspace needs before freezing the MVP around a differentiating downstream workflow.
lessons.regression_check: Create or import a novel, open a chapter, edit from reading mode, restart, and verify text remains before entering any specialized revision flow.

lessons.symptom: Deleted sessions remained in the previous recovery snapshot and could reappear after primary corruption.
lessons.cause: Destructive deletion reused the normal save rotation that intentionally retained the previous primary snapshot.
lessons.proposed_change: Model destructive commits separately and replace every primary, backup, and pending snapshot with the post-deletion state.
lessons.regression_check: Corrupt primary after per-session deletion and erase-all, then assert recovery cannot return deleted IDs.

lessons.symptom: A newly installed simulator build opened the load-failure screen before any user data existed.
lessons.cause: The repository returned a const empty list and the store attempted to sort it in place.
lessons.proposed_change: Copy repository results into a mutable list before sorting and always exercise a true fresh-install runtime state.
lessons.regression_check: Load a fresh file repository, perform the first write, restart, and assert the session is readable.

lessons.symptom: Home and Scan overflowed on a 320 by 720 viewport at 1.6 text scale.
lessons.cause: Horizontal rows assumed that headings, controls, progress, and metrics fit at default text scale.
lessons.proposed_change: Use wrapping or vertical composition for mixed text and controls, and cover every core page at compact large-text settings.
lessons.regression_check: Navigate Home, Queue, Scan, Editor, and Summary at 320 by 720 and 1.6 text scale with no framework exception.

lessons.symptom: A visually correct simulator PNG failed mechanical Store screenshot checks because it retained alpha.
lessons.cause: Raw simulator capture properties were not treated as release metadata requirements.
lessons.proposed_change: Mechanically inspect dimensions and alpha for each required device class and preserve no-alpha PNG candidates.
lessons.regression_check: Preflight must pass screenshot checks for 1320 by 2868 iPhone and 2064 by 2752 iPad PNG files.
